Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that creates two threads. One thread prints even numbers and the other thread prints odd numbers up to a given limit. Your program should: Take an integer input from the user. Create two threads: one to print even numbers and another to print odd numbers up to the given limit. 
Input Description:
A single integer. 
Output Description:
Even and odd numbers up to the given limit printed by two separate threads. 
Sample Input:
8 
Sample Output:
Even Thread: 0
Even Thread: 2
Even Thread: 4
Even Thread: 6
Even Thread: 8
Odd Thread: 1
Odd Thread: 3
Odd Thread: 5
Odd Thread: 7
